# siheom

> Data-first frontend test interpreter. Tests are data (given / action / assert steps); an interpreter runs them in a real browser.

## Docs

- Korean (default): /intro
- English: /en/intro
- Glossary: CONTEXT.md in repo root

## Primary API (@siheom/react)

```ts
import { actions, assertions, given, query, runSiheom } from "@siheom/react";
```

Do not use `await` in the test body — `return runSiheom(...)`.

## Runtime

- Recommended: vitest browser mode (Playwright provider), real Chromium
- Not recommended: jsdom, happy-dom

## Factory (@siheom/core)

- `extendSiheom` — add new registry keys (actions, assertions, givens, messages)
- `overrideSiheom` — replace existing registry keys
- Runtime contract: framework supplies `given.render`, not a separate Runtime type

## Locators

- `query.*` uses ARIA role + accessible name (same information as screen readers)
- No CSS selectors, test ids, or xpath

## Failure reports

- Structured logs + original error + accessibility snapshot
- Section headers customizable via message map (`logs`, `originalErrorMessage`, `a11ySnapshot`)

## E2E

- Multi-page E2E is not supported yet; Playwright-based E2E may come later
- Component/integration tests in real browser are the current focus

## Optional

- Full docs site: `bun run --filter '@siheom/docs' dev`
- AI skill (when published): `npx skills add twinstae/siheom-ts`
